verdictRationale: Two substantive defects, both provable from the committed bytes. The finalized artifact carries the personal name 'Courtney Bailey' in the Administrative Office of the Courts records-officer certification cell on page 2 — inherited from the pinned source, baked in by flattening, sitting in no declared rectangle and therefore invisible to every check the contract runs, which is why this family reads clean everywhere else. And the recorded sourceUrl points at the nonviolent-felony instructions rather than at AOC-CR-298. Placement itself is correct: five bound values in their own rectangles, no strays, and the certificate-of-service block — the defect class NE DC-1-15 is still held for — is blank. §2 is unperformed here as everywhere in this shard, and it is the step that would resolve the first defect.

findings.severity: systemic, affects all four families in this shard
findings.objection: regionHeading and effectiveLabel are attributed across columns and across rows, so the protection decision is frequently made on text that does not belong to the field.
findings.observedResult: The petitioner name / street / city block occupies one column at x=37-38 with a shared width of 278. Its three widgets receive three different region headings, each a different line of the form's title block in the adjacent right-hand column: on AOC-CR-287 'PETITION AND ORDER OF EXPUNCTION', 'UNDER G.S. 15A-146(a) OR G.S. 15A-146(a1)' and 'G.S. 15A-146, 15A-150'; on AOC-CR-288 'PETITION AND ORDER OF EXPUNCTION', 'UNDER G.S. 15A-146(a2)' and 'G.S. 15A-146, 15A-150'; on AOC-CR-296 'STATE VERSUS', 'DISTRICT ATTORNEY PETITION' and 'AND ORDER OF EXPUNCTION'; on AOC-CR-298 'STATE VERSUS', '(NONVIOLENT MISDEMEANOR(S))' and 'G.S. 15A-145.5, -150'. Separately, effectiveLabel is a whole caption row rather than a field's own caption: PetitionerState, PetitionerZip, DriversLicenseState, Race and Sex on AOC-CR-287, and State, ZipCode, DLState and NameAtty on AOC-CR-288, all carry the identical label 'Drivers License No.StateRaceSex'; DateOfBirth, Sex and AgeAtTimeOfOffense on AOC-CR-287 and DOB and CityAtty on AOC-CR-288 all carry the identical label 'Date Of BirthFull Social Security No.' followed by an undecoded run. The refusal categories that result are untrue on their face: PetitionerZip and NameAtty refused as 'race', DOB and CityAtty refused as 'money', DateOfBirth refused as 'money'. Most such misfires are fail-closed and cost only a false reason, but on AOC-CR-296 the same mechanism refuses two fields the participant must complete, and PROTECT_RULES order means an accidental early match ('money', 'race') pre-empts the correct later rule ('attorney') that the module was extended to catch.
findings.requiredResult: A widget's region is the section heading that governs its own column band, and a widget's effectiveLabel is its own caption, not the concatenation of every caption in the row. A refusal names the reason that actually applies.
findings.smallestCorrection: Constrain region attribution to headings whose horizontal extent overlaps the widget's column, and constrain caption attribution to the caption cell above or left of the widget within that column, rather than the whole row. Re-derive the maps and re-render; no family file is hand-edited.
findings.whyItMattersEvenWhereOutputIsClean: §5 says not to infer safety from a missing class. This is the same hazard with a class present: the class is recorded, is relied on, and is demonstrably not about the field it is attached to. Where it happens to fail closed the artifact is still correct; there is no guarantee the next form fails in the safe direction.

findings.severity: substantive, participant-facing, not previously recorded anywhere
findings.fieldOrRectangle: the 'Name Of Records Officer (type or print)' cell of the 'REPORT BY ADMINISTRATIVE OFFICE OF THE COURTS' block; the text occupies x=112.3-187.0, y=599.1-613.4 in PDF user space
findings.observedResult: The finalized, flattened artifact carries the visible personal name 'Courtney Bailey' inside an Administrative Office of the Courts certification block. The name is present identically in the blank rendering, so the renderer did not write it: it arrives with the pinned source and is baked in permanently by flattening. It sits in no declared widget rectangle — the census records only RecordsOfficerSignedDate at x=36 y=600 w=72 for that row and no field at all for the name cell — so no classification, refusal or protected-area check can reach it. The string 'Courtney' does not appear anywhere in this repository, and protected-fields-scan.json states its own basis as 'what the renderer wrote', which is why every existing check reports this family clean.
findings.requiredResult: A participant-facing artifact carries no third party's name in a court or agency certification region. Either the pinned source is confirmed to print that name as part of the official blank form, in which case the fact is recorded explicitly and deliberately accepted, or the source is replaced with a pristine blank and the family re-rendered.
findings.smallestCorrection: Open the pinned source under RCAP_BUNDLE_EXTRACT and look at that cell. If the official blank form does not print the name, re-acquire AOC-CR-298 REV-2025-07 and re-render. If it does, record it. Independently, extend the protected-area check so it audits what is visible in a protected region rather than only what the renderer wrote — as written it can never detect an inherited value.

findings.severity: substantive provenance defect, provable without the corpus
findings.observedResult: Both records carry sourceUrl 'https://www.nccourts.gov/documents/forms/petition-and-order-of-expunction-under-gs-15a-1455-nonviolent-felonyies-instructions-for-petition-and-order-of-expunction-under-gs-15a-1455-nonviolent-felonyies'. That locator names nonviolent FELONIES and names the INSTRUCTIONS. The artifact it is attached to is AOC-CR-298, whose own printed title is 'PETITION AND ORDER OF EXPUNCTION UNDER G.S. 15A-145.5 (NONVIOLENT MISDEMEANOR(S))', whose footer reads 'AOC-CR-298, Rev. 7/25 (replaced AOC-CR-281 for nonviolent misdemeanor petitions)', and which states on its own face 'For expunction of nonviolent felonies under G.S. 15A-145.5, use form AOC-CR-297.' The URL does not contain the string AOC-CR-298. This is the only family of the four carrying a published locator; the other three correctly carry a master-library: archive locator and digest.
findings.requiredResult: The recorded sourceUrl resolves to AOC-CR-298 itself, or it is null and the archive path and digest stand as the locator.
findings.smallestCorrection: Null the sourceUrl for this family and let the master-library locator stand, as the other three families in this shard already do, or replace it with the AOC-CR-298 form URL after checking it resolves to this form.
findings.whyItMatters: the lane's own stated rule is that a fabricated provenance locator is indistinguishable from a real one until somebody follows it. This one is not fabricated but it is wrong, and it was adopted from the links workbook without being checked against the form's own identity — the same failure with a different origin.
